## First Verse 
<!--Put the first five lines of a poem by Lewis Carrol in this section!-->

"The Queen of Hearts she made some tarts  
All on a summer day:  
The Knave of Hearts he stole those tarts,  
And took them quite away!"

## Second Verse
<!--Put the first five lines of a poem by Robert Frost here!-->

Two roads diverged in a yellow wood,  
And sorry I could not travel both  
And be one traveler, long I stood  
And looked down one as far as I could  
To where it bent in the undergrowth;

## Last Verse
<!--Put a short poem of your choice 8-20 lines,here!-->

Love can lift your soul or leave your spirit cursed,  
A beautiful beginning, yet an ending unrehearsed.  
It holds the sweetest dreams, yet hides the deepest pain,  
A sunshine after storms, or a never-ending rain.  
Love is both a blessing and a curse, be careful which double edge sword you choose,  
For some hearts give you everything, while others leave you bruised.
So guard your heart with wisdom, don't let passion make you blind,  
For the greatest love can heal you, or destroy you from inside.
